description: Compute a multi-period amortisation / depreciation / EIR amortisation schedule by rolling reportingDate forward one period at a time. Supported standards: ias16 (PPE depreciation), ias38 (intangible amortisation), ias40 (investment property — cost model), ias23 (borrowing cost capitalisation), ifrs9 (EIR amortisation), ifrs16 (lessee ROU + lease liability). Each period is the same item with its dates moved on — no manual carry-forward required. ias16 / ias38 / ias40 (cost model): the cost, dates, residual value and method are kept, and the closing accumulated depreciation (amortisation) and accumulated impairment carry into the next period (IAS 16.30, IAS 38.74, IAS 36.63); an opening the engine derives from the dates is left to it. A period's IAS 36 test (indicators, fair value, value in use, recoverable amount) is not carried: a clean assessment (impairmentIndicatorsPresent: false) is assumed for the later periods and stated in that row's assumptions; after a positive one the next period asks for its own assessment — state it in periodFacts, keyed by that period's reportingDate, and the schedule rolls on it (IAS 36.9, 36.63). Deferred tax: the closing deferred tax balance carries as the next opening (IAS 12.58); the tax base is an amount at each reporting date and is not carried (state it per period in periodFacts); the tax rate and the recoverability judgement are carried as stated assumptions unless periodFacts states them. ias40 under the fair value model is refused (each period is measured at the fair value at its own reporting date, IAS 40.33, 40.35) — call ifr_calculate per period. ifrs16: the lease is rolled on its own dates; a restoration obligation measured at commencement becomes restorationAtCommencement (IFRS 16.24(d)) and the current estimate is carried as a stated assumption (IAS 37.59). ifrs9 (amortised cost only — an instrument at fair value is refused from period 2, its measurement being the fair value at each reporting date, IFRS 9.5.2.1, IFRS 13.9): the cost and dated cash flows are kept (the effective interest rate is derived from them), the closing loss allowance and ECL stage carry into the next period (IFRS 9.5.5.3, 5.4.1(b)), and the credit-risk facts and fair value of the date are carried as stated assumptions. ias23: the earlier periods' expenditure is carried into cumulativeExpenditureAtPreviousReportingDate (IAS 23.18); each later period's own expenditure is stated in periodFacts. Every standard: a measure stated at the reporting date (…AtReportingDate) is the next period's …AtPreviousReportingDate. Returns a schedule array: [{period, previousReportingDate, reportingDate, carryingAmount, journalEntries, charges:{depreciation, impairment, interest, pnlImpact}, assumptions}] — charges are the period's own (depreciation or amortisation; interest: the lease liability's or instrument's effective interest, or IAS 23's borrowing costs expensed). charges.impairment: on ias16 / ias38 / ias40 every period makes the mandatory IAS 36.9 assessment, so it is the measured loss or 0 (no indication, or no loss); null on ias23 / ifrs9 / ifrs16, whose schedule carries no IAS 36 test. A period that is refused ends the schedule with its error. Cost: 1 credit per successfully computed period. Cap: 60 periods.

input.description: Required, an object. Initial period input — same shape as ifr_calculate input for this standard. reportingDate is period-1 end date; previousReportingDate is period-0 end date.

periodFacts.description: An array. ias16 / ias38 / ias40 / ias23 only: the facts of a LATER period, one entry per period, keyed by that period's reportingDate — { reportingDate, ...facts }. ias16 / ias38 / ias40: the standard's own IAS 36 test facts of the date (impairmentIndicatorsPresent, the indicator flags, fairValue, costsOfDisposal, valueInUseAmount, recoverableAmount, reversalIndicatorsPresent, …; IAS 36.9) and the IAS 12 facts of the date (taxBase, dismantlingProvisionTaxBase, currentTaxRate, futureTaxableProfitProbable; IAS 12.5, 12.47). ias23: the period's own assetExpenditures (IAS 23.17(a), 23.18) — required for every later period of a qualifying asset, an empty array where none was incurred. Period 1's facts stay in input. Any other key is refused.

periodicityMonths.description: One of 1, 3, 6, 12. Length of each period in months. Default: 12 (annual). Other values: 1 (monthly), 3 (quarterly), 6 (semi-annual).

periods.description: Required: an integer from 1 to 60. Number of periods to compute (each period = periodicityMonths). Cap: 60. Each computed period costs 1 credit.

standard.description: Required. One of ias16, ias23, ias38, ias40, ifrs9, ifrs16. Standard for the rolling schedule — must be one that has a depreciating or amortising asset/liability

name: ifr_amortisation_schedule
